selected_primary.summary: Classical equality-constrained quadratic optimization uses KKT equations. Positive-definite block elimination solves the associated Schur complement and should exploit structure rather than only a generic dense factorization. The book scope is finite dimensional; the continuous projected-loop identity below is this project’s elementary algebraic specialization, not a quotation or a theorem attributed to the book.
